tenant_role_consistency.name: tenant_role_consistency
tenant_role_consistency.value: (role = 'tallpa_owner' AND tenant_id IS NULL) OR (role IN ('tenant_owner', 'tenant_manager', 'tenant_technician') AND tenant_id IS NOT NULL)

technician_role_consistency.name: technician_role_consistency
technician_role_consistency.value: (role = 'tenant_technician' AND technician_id IS NOT NULL) OR (role != 'tenant_technician' AND technician_id IS NULL)
